== Biography ==

Two is one of three gardeners employed in painting the roses of the Queen's garden. When asked by Alice to explain their curious work, Two speaks up where Five and Seven remain silent, recounting in a low voice that a white rose-tree was planted in error where a red one should have been. Fearful that the Queen's discovery of this mistake would result in the loss of their heads, Two explains that the gardeners are doing their best to paint the white roses red before the Queen arrives.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — ally. Two seems willing to confide in her about the gardeners' predicament.

'''[[Five]]''' — acquaintance. Appears to work alongside Two on the painting task.

'''[[Queen]]''' — enemy. Two's actions appear driven by fear of the Queen's discovery and fatal judgment.

'''[[Seven]]''' — acquaintance. A fellow gardener who shares Two's predicament.
